candidate: H43 exact-budget role-conditioned nonlinear task-atom feature atlas
purpose: Test the narrow H42 failure attribution: whether task-atom-conditioned nonlinear coordinate masks can provide measured ambient orientation and spectrum that a 64-direction linear shallow-transport atlas cannot.

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: mean of all 239 states independently for each matrix
frozen_inventory.pc_normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for every matrix PC
frozen_inventory.pc_weights: eigenvalue normalized within the measured top-16 set; also report total-path-weighted recovery

frozen_decoder.formula: X_nrk=sqrt(P_n) QL_rk D_n QR_rk^T; B_nr0=D_n; B_nrk=unit(GELU(s_k X_nrk+b_k)-mean(GELU(s_k X_nrk+b_k))) for k>0; Yhat_n=sum_k a_nk B_nrk
frozen_decoder.branch_zero_anchor: exact identity task atom with no nonlinear feature
frozen_decoder.other_branch_anchor: procedural uniform angles on [-pi, pi] from the registered branch seed
frozen_decoder.feature_activation: exact PyTorch GELU tanh approximation disabled
frozen_decoder.feature_schedule: for branch k in 1..63 use scale[(k-1) mod 4] and bias[floor((k-1)/4) mod 5]
frozen_decoder.feature_standardization: subtract scalar mean over all matrix entries, divide by Frobenius norm with 1e-12 floor

fit.objective: mean eigenvalue-weighted ridge projection capture of each training node's top-16 temporal PCs into its 64 generated nonlinear branch atoms
fit.fit_all: learn one shared nonlinear 64-branch bank independently for each three-node role
fit.leave_one_out: learn the shared role bank on the other two same-role nodes; fit only legal 64-dimensional projection coordinates for the held-out node
fit.base_control: identical nonlinear procedural atlas with learned residual angles fixed at zero; local coordinates still optimally projected
fit.forbidden_target_access: no held-out PC enters shared-angle fitting

systems_preflight.preflight_scope: both role fit-all fits plus one held-out fold per role

routing_after_pass: Run the identical nonlinear bank on chronological-late and disjoint-stream residual PCs before any LM training.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact nonlinear task-atom atlas. Write theory and exact accounting for H44, a charged small global atom library plus procedural residual, before code.
forbidden_followups: scale, bias, activation, branch, stage, prompt, seed, ridge, iteration, learning-rate, role, or target sweep
claiming a no-go for charged global atoms, low-bit dense cores, externally amortized information, or alternate-solution manifolds
